sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def bset(fr):
    N=[(r,c) for r,l in enumerate(fr.ascii.split('\n')) for c,ch in enumerate(l) if ch=='N']
    return frozenset({(r//6,c//6) for (r,c) in N})
before=bset(current_frame)
res=action(['LEFT'],intent='explore')
after=bset(current_frame)
def ppos(fr):
    for r,l in enumerate(fr.ascii.split('\n')):
        if 'Y' in l: return r, l.index('Y')
print("result:", {k:res.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done','game_over']} if isinstance(res,dict) else res)
print("player:", ppos(current_frame))
print("blocks changed:", before!=after, "n=",len(after))
print("before:",sorted(before)); print("after:",sorted(after))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def bset(fr):
    N=[(r,c) for r,l in enumerate(fr.ascii.split('\n')) for c,ch in enumerate(l) if ch=='N']
